newsitem.title: USA: BNCCORP Inc to offer $15 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: BNCCORP Inc to offer $15 mln in notes.

text.p: BNCCORP Inc said Wednesday it is launching a $15 million public offering of 8.625 percent subordinated notes due 2004.
The bank holding company said it will use the net proceeds to repay about $9.6 million of debt outstanding under its revolving line of credit with its commercial lender.

BNCCORP said it expects to borrow additional funds under its revolving line of credit in order to provide more working capital for general corporate purposes, including loans at BNC Financial, its non-bank commercial finance subsidiary.
Dain Bosworth is the sole underwriter of the offering. Notes will be sold in $1,000 denominations.
